full_prompt_en: A square early twentieth-century editorial illustration shows a stylish young man seated on a low ledge in a relaxed yet carefully posed position. One leg bends high with a polished dark shoe planted near him; the other leg extends toward the lower right. He wears cream trousers, a dark waistcoat, patterned neckwear, and a warm tan jacket whose right elbow angles outward as his hand rests on his hip. His other hand touches his chin, and he looks toward the left with a thoughtful, reserved expression. Behind him, layer decorative warm-brown line drawings of classical figures, scrolling foliage, and framed panels over an ivory ground. The composition lets some of these ornamental sketches remain incomplete, giving the background the feel of an artist's elaborate working board. Model the man's face, hands, cloth folds, and shoes with confident opaque brushwork and firm shadow shapes; his silhouette should read clearly against the lighter decoration. The image uses a palette of caramel, ochre, cream, black, and muted blue in the socks and small accents. The light is even and warm, with deeper painted shadows under the bent arm and folds rather than realistic sunlight. The image preserves visible brush texture and selective unfinished edges. The overall composition is elegant, graphic, and richly layered while retaining a clear focal figure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形二十世纪初的编辑插画描绘一位穿着讲究的年轻男子坐在低矮边台上，姿势轻松却经过精心安排。一条腿高高弯起，擦亮的深色鞋踩在身旁；另一条腿向右下延伸。他穿奶油色长裤、深色马甲、带纹样领巾和暖棕褐外套，右肘向外折，手扶腰侧；另一只手触着下巴，神情沉静而若有所思地看向左方。背后在象牙底上层叠暖棕线描的古典人物、卷草和装饰画框。其中一些装饰草图保留未完成状态，使背景像画家繁复的工作板。男子的脸、手、衣褶和鞋以果断不透明笔触与清楚阴影块塑造；剪影要从更浅的装饰中清晰读出。色彩为焦糖、赭黄、奶油、黑色，并在袜子和小处加低调蓝色。光线均匀而温暖，弯起的胳膊和衣褶下用较深的画面阴影，而非写实日晒。画面保留可见笔触和局部未画满的边缘。整体优雅、图形化而层次繁富，同时保有清楚的视觉焦点。
style_prompt_en: Elegant vintage editorial painting that pairs assertive opaque brush modeling with ornamental sepia line drawings. The image uses cream paper, caramel and ochre planes, deep black accents, selective cool notes, and a dense but pale decorative surround. Shape volume through angular clothlike shadow blocks and purposeful edge variation; The rendering allows unfinished pencil or ink tracery to show beneath and around the stronger painted forms. The image keeps the focal mass clear within layered classical ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 优雅复古编辑绘画，把果断的不透明笔触塑形与装饰性棕褐线描结合。画面采用奶油色纸面、焦糖和赭黄色面、深黑点缀、少量冷色，以及密集但浅淡的装饰性周边。画面以有棱角的衣褶式阴影块和有意变化的边缘塑造体积；画面让未完成的铅笔或墨线痕迹在更强的绘画形体下方与四周显露。繁复古典装饰中仍须保留清楚的视觉主体。
theme_en: A seated gentleman in tan jacket within an ornate editorial illustration
theme_zh: 华丽编辑插画中穿棕褐夹克端坐的绅士
name: J. C. Leyendecker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
